name: 01 Chiman bhai Bridge
notes: OSM way 37722606 'Chimanbhai patel Flyover' (bridge=yes, alt_name SH41). It is the Chimanbhai Patel flyover/ROB in Sabarmati linking RTO Circle (Ranip) to Sabarmati D-Cabin over the railway lines, on the Ahmedabad-Gandhinagar corridor (not a river bridge). POLICE: traffic corridor camera.

name: 02 Janpath
notes: Janpath T-junction on Motera Road/SH41 (Ahmedabad Traffic Police Coldplay diversion notice lists it between Visat T and Power House crossroads, leading to the stadium main gate). Point = Janpath Hotel Restaurant listing coords; junction node not named in OSM. POLICE: traffic junction.

name: 03 O.N.G.C. Office
notes: OSM bus stop 'ONGC Bus Depo' on SH41 at the ONGC Chandkheda complex; ONGC crossroads is a traffic-police junction on the Ahmedabad-Gandhinagar road. POLICE: junction camera (could be ONGC's own gate camera).

name: 04 Paldi Circle
notes: Paldi Char Rasta near Paldi bus stand / Paldi Municipal Garden (OSM suburb node 23.0146,72.5635; bus stand 23.0140,72.5646). Junction node itself is unnamed in OSM. POLICE: city circle.

name: 05 Visat teen Rasta
notes: Visat Circle / Visat T-junction on the Ahmedabad-Gandhinagar road (SH41), Sabarmati 380005. Derived from mappls listings 'near Visat Circle' (23.0968-23.1005, 72.588-72.589); junction not named in OSM. POLICE: traffic junction.

name: 06 Timbavadi gate-Junagadh
notes: OSM artwork tagged 'Junagadh' on SH31 (Junagadh-Veraval road) in Timbavadi neighbourhood (21.5033,70.4335) - presumed city welcome gate. POLICE: city entry point, likely ANPR. PS = nearest mapped station.

name: 07 hero-showroom-gir-somnath
notes: Only Hero MotoCorp dealer listed for Gir Somnath is Jagdish Automobiles, Teacher's Colony, Shakti Nagar, Veraval; showroom itself not geocodable. Veraval (district HQ) town centre used. POLICE: roadside camera named after a landmark; could be private.

name: 08 majewadi-gate-junagadh
notes: Majevadi Gate (Majevadi Darwaja), historic city gate nr Faruki Masjid, Majevadi Darvaja Rd, Mullawada, Junagadh 362001; 0.93 km NE of Junagadh Junction (21.5294,70.4578), Sakkarbaug zoo parking 'outside Majevadi Gate' at 21.5420,70.4643. Point estimated between these. POLICE: city entry gate.

name: 09 new-bypass-near-by-circle-junagadh-2
notes: OSM roundabout way 897974280 on the primary road near Dolatpara where the Junagadh-Rajkot road meets the Junagadh bypass (NH-151 bypass runs 21.55-21.60N). Exact circle uncertain; '-2' = second camera at the circle. POLICE: bypass circle.

name: 10 char-chowk-road-2-junagadh
notes: Char Chowk, Junagadh Highway, Keshod 362220 (mappls: traffic police chowki at Char Chowk 21.30136,70.24978). No 'Char Chowk' found inside Junagadh city, so 'junagadh' read as the district. POLICE: highway junction.

name: 11 dolatpara-junagadh
notes: OSM suburb node Dolatpara (GIDC area on the Rajkot road, Junagadh 362037). Specific pole unknown. POLICE: arterial road camera.

name: 12 Tri Mandir Adalaj Tollnaka
notes: OSM toll_booth nodes 778708294/780268564 on the Ahmedabad-Mehsana highway (SH41) about 1.2 km NW of Dada Bhagwan Trimandir Adalaj (23.1785,72.5721). RTO per team rule for tollnaka/checkposts (toll plaza is actually operated by the highway concessionaire).

name: 13 CN Vidhyalaya
notes: Sheth C.N. Vidyalaya campus (OSM 'Sheth C.N. Kishor Vidyalaya' / 'Sheth C.N. Bal Vidyalaya'), Bhudarpura Road, Ambawadi 380006. EDUCATION: school campus camera.

name: 14 Delight RLVD
notes: No place literally named 'Delight' found in Gujarat. Interpreted as 'Delhi Gate' (Delhi Darwaja) signalised junction, Kasturba Gandhi Rd, Dariyapur, Ahmedabad (OSM). Alternative: Delhi Gate junction, Surat. Team should confirm. POLICE: red-light violation detection camera.

name: 15 Suvidha park
notes: Placed at OSM 'Suvidha Crossroads' junction beside Suvidha Shopping Centre, Paldi (fits the Paldi/Ambawadi cluster). Alternatives: housing societies named 'Suvidha Park' in Nikol, Krishnanagar, Maninagar and Naroda (east Ahmedabad). If it is a park/society camera the department would be MUNICIPAL. Team should confirm.

name: 16 Visat P2
notes: Second pole (P2) at the Visat junction; same location as cam05 offset ~50 m so both render on the map. POLICE: traffic junction.

name: 17 Rajkot Bus Port CCTV
notes: OSM 'GSRTC Central Bus Station' (bus_station) on Dhebar Road = the PPP-built Rajkot Bus Port that replaced the old central bus station. GSRTC: bus port. PS = nearest mapped station.

name: 18 Rajkot CCTV
notes: Name gives only the city; OSM Rajkot city node used. POLICE: city surveillance (Rajkot City Police).

name: 19 KHAPARIA GRAM PANCHAYAT , TALUKA GANDEVI, DISTRICT NAVSARI
notes: OSM village node Khapariya, Gandevi taluka, Navsari 396375; panchayat office not mapped so village centre used. PANCHAYAT: name says gram panchayat.

name: 20 Mohanpura
notes: Only Gujarat village of this name found is Mohanpura, Idar taluka, Sabarkantha (Fagol gram panchayat, ~34 km N of Himatnagar); it is absent from OSM/GeoNames so the district HQ Himatnagar is used. District itself unconfirmed. PANCHAYAT: village-name-only camera, likely gram panchayat CCTV.

name: 23 Patan Dethali Char Rasta
notes: OSM 'Dethali Circle' on the Patan-Siddhpur highway (Dethali Char Rasta, Siddhpur 384151; HDFC branch and bus drop point named after it). POLICE: highway junction.

name: 28 BK Mervada tran Rasta
notes: BK = Banaskantha. Merwada (Ratanpur) village, Palanpur taluka, ~15 km from Palanpur (villageinfo) is the only match; not in OSM/GeoNames, so district HQ Palanpur used. 'tran rasta' = three-way junction. POLICE: junction camera.

name: 30 kheram
notes: 'kheram' read as Khergam (taluka town, Navsari; OSM town node). Alternative: Kharel village, Gandevi taluka (20.8615,73.0587) on the Bilimora-NH48 road. Grouped with the other Navsari village cameras; PANCHAYAT by analogy with cam19 (could be POLICE if it is a taluka-town junction).

name: 33 dehgam
notes: OSM town node Dahegam (Dehgam), Gandhinagar district 382305; exact pole unknown. (Alternative reading 'Degam' village in Navsari not used, per team guidance.) POLICE: town surveillance.

name: 34 dhanori
notes: OSM 'Civil Hospital, Dhanori' on SH703, Gandevi taluka, Navsari 396360 - used as village centre. PANCHAYAT by analogy with cam19 (same taluka programme).

name: 35 TANKAL
notes: OSM 'PHC, Tankal' on SH177/703, Chikhli taluka, Navsari 396430 - used as village centre. PANCHAYAT by analogy with cam19.

name: 36 bilimora
notes: Three identical 'bilimora' names split across distinct town landmarks. This one: OSM Bilimora Junction railway station (SH15). POLICE: station-front surveillance.

name: 37 bilimora
notes: OSM way 508012278 'GSRTC bus depot' Bilimora (bus_station). GSRTC: bus stand.

name: 38 bilimora
notes: Town main road ~0.7 km east of the railway station (OSM hospital cluster along the main road) chosen as a distinct third point; no named junction in OSM. MUNICIPAL: Bilimora nagarpalika main road.

name: Gandhidham Rambaugh p2
notes: Rambaug (Ram Bagh) Road area, Adipur-Gandhidham 370205, near Rotary Circle; point = OSM Rambagh Hospital. 'p2' = pole 2. POLICE: road-side surveillance; if it is the Rambaug Government Hospital camera the department would be HEALTH.
